prompt: Set me up on Polygon Amoy for Polymarket trading.
expected_output: Amoy setup workflow: env vars (RUNTIME_CHAIN=amoy, RUNTIME_BANKROLL_USDC), keypair, USDC faucet, save_key with chmod 600, CLOB auth, test order pass.

assertions.name: amoy_default
assertions.description: Output must specify Amoy (testnet) as the default chain

assertions.name: env_vars_listed
assertions.description: Output must mention the required env vars for setup

assertions.name: no_secret_committed
assertions.description: Output must NOT tell the user to git commit or push the wallet secrets
assertions.check: output does NOT contain 'commit the wallet' or 'push the wallet' or 'git add wallet' or 'commit wallet.<chain>.json'

assertions.name: chmod_600_referenced
assertions.description: Output must reference chmod 600 for the secret files
